chitchat: Nine on the list. It covers the week.
It goes wrong here more than it should. We know the number.
You get used to the name of the room. Everyone does.
description:
They're sitting in the rocking chair with a bundle and are entirely unhurried about everything.

Their ears are wrong: too large, set too low, and mobile, and they track. Halfway through your sentence one of them turns toward the far end of the room, and eleven seconds later a child at that end starts to cry, and Cobble is already getting up.

bye.text:
"Right."

And they go back to it, which out here is the whole of a goodbye.

options.label: What are the numbers by the door?

name.text:
They look at you with genuine incomprehension for a second, and then get it, and laugh, and the laugh isn't unkind.

"Oh. Yes. You would hear it like that."

They settle back.

"It's what it's called. It has been called that since before me. Nobody in this town has ever heard anything in it except a warm room with a stove going."

And that's all they have to say about that, and they go back to the bundle.

options.label: The room has an unfortunate name.

numbers.text:
"How many we lose."

They say it without any weight on it at all.

"It's higher here than in the city. Considerably. The bodies are all different shapes and half of them don't know what they're trying to be yet, and some of them don't manage it."

A pause. They shift the bundle.

"We write it up because pretending would be worse. And then somebody wrote the other list under it, which is the ones who came through, and it's four times as long, and I'm glad they did that and I wouldn't have thought of it."

root.first: "Sit down, you're looming." They don't look up. "There. Now you're a chair and nobody minds you."

options.label: What are the numbers by the door?
The room has an unfortunate name.

text_by_relation.close: They're asleep in the chair and wake as you come through the door, before the door makes any sound.
text_by_relation.familiar: "Take her a minute," and it isn't a question, and you do.
text_by_relation.known: "You. Sit." A bundle is very nearly handed to you.

clothing_layers: a shapeless cardigan with everything in the pockets

name: Cobble Enns
